Hello everyone! The module system in Lean has been available for over 6 months. #41950 will enable an option in mathlib that will cause a warning for downstream libraries that satisfy the following conditions:

  • they depend on a version of Mathlib that contains #41950
  • and do not use the module system

For clarity, this does not immediately cause any breakage. However, this is encouragement for downstream libraries to transition to the module system. Future versions of Mathlib might drop support for certain features that require non-module-system libraries.

For example, the simpNF linter currently does not assume the module system is enabled, in the future it might assume that and stop working in libraries that do not use the module system.

Finally, the option allowNonModules can be turned on in a downstream project to turn off this warning.

I found this useful: https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/blob/master/script/Modulize.lean
Maybe it should be advertised more.
Generally, I'm wondering whether Skills for upgrading lean versions would be useful.
